title: Fall
prompt: The robot falls. Gravity is 100 per second per second, from `y` and `vy` both at 0.0. After 60 frames at 60 per second, y_after_fall reports a fall speed of 100.

tests.name: After one second the fall speed is 100

hints: Two lines per frame in _process: gravity times delta joins vy, then vy times delta joins y.

docs.name: func _process(delta):
docs.what: Godot calls this once per frame, about 60 times a second. delta is the frame time in seconds.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable keeps its value from one frame to the next.

docs.name: round(x)
docs.what: Returns the nearest whole number as a float.
